content.short: Mendi Finance is the primary decentralized lending protocol on Linea, offering interest-bearing asset markets.
content.description:
Mendi Finance is the leading non-custodial decentralized lending platform built natively for the Linea network. The protocol allows users to supply various digital assets to earn interest and borrow against them as collateral in a transparent, peer-to-peer environment. Designed for maximum capital efficiency and security, Mendi Finance provides essential financial infrastructure for the Linea ecosystem, enabling participants to manage their liquidity with institutional-grade precision.

Powered by the MENDI token, the protocol features a sustainable revenue-sharing model that rewards stakers with a portion of protocol fees. By leveraging Linea's zkEVM technology, Mendi Finance delivers a high-speed and low-cost user experience while inheriting the robust security of the Ethereum mainnet. Through its focus on professional risk management and community-driven governance, Mendi Finance is empowering users to build and manage sophisticated decentralized portfolios within the rapidly growing Linea landscape.
content.meta: Mendi Finance provides decentralized lending and borrowing services on the Linea network with revenue-sharing rewards.
